records.translation: 你好，@。^這東西一直放在工具棚裡積灰塵。我想你也許用得上。  ^   ——肯特%item id (O)286 1 (O)287 1 (O)288 1 (O)787 1 %%[#]來自肯特的禮物

records.source: Hey,^I thought it would be fun to send you a letter. I don't really know what to write, though.^ Here, I've enclosed a treat for you. Don't tell anyone, but I snagged this from the back room of JojaMart ages ago.^Okay, see you soon. ^   -Shane %item id (O)215 1 (O)206 1 %%[#]A Gift From Shane
records.translation: 嘿：^我想寫封信給你應該挺有意思。不過，我也不知道該寫些什麼。^喏，隨信附上一份點心。別告訴任何人，這是我很久以前從 Joja 超市後面的倉庫順手拿的。^好啦，待會兒見。^   ——謝恩 %item id (O)215 1 (O)206 1 %%[#]來自謝恩的禮物

records.source: Greetings, young adept.^I have enclosed in this package an item of arcane significance. Use it wisely.   ^   -M. Rasmodius, Wizard%item id (O)422 1 (O)82 1 (O)84 1 (O)70 1 %%[#]A Gift From the Wizard

records.source: Greetings from Calico Desert!^Come visit me soon, I'm really bored out here :(. I've included a gift from the desert. You can come and thank me in person!   ^   -Sandy %item id (O)88 1 (O)90 1 (O)218 1 %%[#]A Gift From Sandy
records.translation: 來自卡利科沙漠的問候！^快來看我，這裡真的好無聊 :(。隨信附上一份來自沙漠的禮物。你可以親自來謝謝我！   ^   ——珊迪 %item id (O)88 1 (O)90 1 (O)218 1 %%[#]來自珊迪的禮物

records.source: @,^the show was a rockin' success! I wanted to say thanks again for all your help in creating this amazing band. We couldn't have done it without you!   ^   -Sam[#]Sam's Thank-you Note
records.translation: @：^演出大獲成功，簡直嗨翻了！再次感謝你協助我們組成這支超棒的樂團。沒有你，我們不可能辦到！   ^   ——山姆[#]山姆的感謝信

records.source: Dear @,^Thanks again for coming to my art show. It was such a success! I sold nearly all of my sculptures, and everyone was so positive and encouraging! I hope to see you again soon.  ^   -Leah[#]Leah's Thank-you Note
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^再次感謝你來參加我的藝術展。展覽非常成功！我幾乎賣掉了所有雕塑，而且每個人都那麼肯定我、鼓勵我！希望很快能再見到你。  ^   ——莉亞[#]莉亞的感謝信

records.source: @,^I thought it would be fun to write you a note.^ I had so much fun with the cows yesterday... I'm starting to understand why you chose the farmer's life! Hope to see you soon.  ^   -Haley[#]Haley's Note
records.translation: @：^我覺得寫張便條給你一定挺有意思。^昨天和乳牛相處得非常開心……我開始明白你為什麼選擇農夫生活了！希望很快見到你。  ^   ——海莉[#]海莉的便條

records.source: Sorry about what happened at my place yesterday... My mom can get into bad moods sometimes.^Please just forget it happened.  ^   -Penny[#]Penny's Apology
records.translation: 很抱歉昨天在我家發生了那種事……我媽媽有時候心情會很差。^請忘了那件事吧。  ^   ——潘妮[#]潘妮的道歉信

records.source: Dear @,^You've proven your ability to raise chickens, so I'm now selling ducks at my shop!       ^   -Marnie[#]Ducks For Sale!
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^你已經證明自己有能力養雞，所以我的商店現在開始販售鴨子了！       ^   ——瑪妮[#]鴨子上市！

records.source: Dear @,^I now have rabbits in the animal shop! They will provide you with fluffy wool ...and more!       ^   -Marnie[#]Rabbits For Sale!
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^動物商店現在有兔子了！牠們會提供蓬鬆的兔毛……還有更多驚喜！       ^   ——瑪妮[#]兔子上市！

records.source: Dear @,^You've proven your ability to raise cows, so I'm now selling sheep at my shop!       ^   -Marnie[#]Sheep For Sale!
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^你已經證明自己有能力養牛，所以我的商店現在開始販售綿羊了！       ^   ——瑪妮[#]綿羊上市！

records.source: Dear @,^I now have goats available for purchase at the animal shop. You've done well so far!       ^   -Marnie[#]Goats For Sale!
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^動物商店現在有山羊可以購買。你到目前為止做得很好！       ^   ——瑪妮[#]山羊上市！

records.source: Dear @,^You've come a long way since you first arrived. As a result, I've decided to start selling pigs at my shop. These pigs are trained at finding gourmet truffles!       ^   -Marnie[#]Pigs For Sale!
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^自從剛來到這裡，你已經進步了許多。因此，我決定開始在商店販售豬。這些豬受過尋找頂級松露的訓練！       ^   ——瑪妮[#]豬上市！

records.source: @,^I'm going to give you this advice because I like you and I want you to stay in Pelican Town. If there comes a day that you want to ask for someone's hand in marriage, you'll need to give them a 'Mermaid's Pendant'. Don't worry, everyone in Pelican Town understands the significance of the amulet. It's an ancient tradition in this region. Good luck! ^   -Lewis[#]About Mermaid's Pendants
records.translation: @：^因為我很欣賞你，也希望你能留在鵜鶘鎮，所以想給你一項建議。如果有一天你想向某人求婚，就必須送給對方一枚「美人魚墜飾」。別擔心，鵜鶘鎮的每個人都明白這枚護符的意義。這是本地一項古老的傳統。祝你好運！^   ——路易斯[#]關於美人魚墜飾

records.source: @,^It seems like you're starting to get close with some of the townspeople. If you want to show someone that you're romantically interested, you've got to give them one of my beautiful flower bouquets. I'm selling them now, for a very fair price! If you want to start a family someday, this is the first step! ^   -Pierre[#]About Bouquets
records.translation: @：^看來你開始和某些鎮民親近起來了。如果想向某人表達愛慕之意，就得送給對方一束我精心準備的美麗花束。我現在已經開始販售，價格非常公道！如果你希望有一天能建立家庭，這就是第一步！^   ——皮埃爾[#]關於花束

records.source: Dear @,^here is an old recipe that my grandma passed down to me. Enjoy!   ^   -Robin%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Robin's Family Recipe
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^這是祖母傳給我的古老食譜。請享用！   ^   ——羅賓%item cookingRecipe %%[#]羅賓的家傳食譜

records.source: I wanted to say 'thanks' for taking an interest in my work. Here's a cooking recipe that I like. ^   -Demetrius%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Demetrius' Recipe
records.translation: 謝謝你對我的工作感興趣。這是我喜歡的一道料理食譜。^   ——德米特里厄斯%item cookingRecipe %%[#]德米特里厄斯的食譜

records.source: @,^how are you doing? I've enclosed some instructions on how to make one of my favorite fish recipes. ^   -Linus%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Linus' Recipe
records.translation: @：^最近過得如何？隨信附上我最喜歡的一道魚料理的製作方法。^   ——萊納斯%item cookingRecipe %%[#]萊納斯的食譜

records.source: TOP SECRET:^Here's the recipe for my famous blueberry tart.^Don't tell anyone! I'm giving it to you because we are such good friends. ^   -Pierre%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Pierre's Famous Tart
records.translation: 最高機密：^這是我那道著名藍莓塔的食譜。^別告訴任何人！因為我們是這麼要好的朋友，我才把它交給你。^   ——皮埃爾%item cookingRecipe %%[#]皮埃爾的知名藍莓塔

records.source: Dear @,^Nothing is more satisfying than cooking with fresh vegetables from your own garden! I've enclosed a recipe to help you out. Take care, ^   -Caroline%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Caroline's Recipe
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^沒有什麼比用自家菜園的新鮮蔬菜做菜更令人滿足了！隨信附上一份食譜，希望能幫上忙。保重，^   ——卡洛琳%item cookingRecipe %%[#]卡洛琳的食譜

records.source: Figured I'd give you this recipe I had laying around. Try not to burn it. ^   -George%item cookingRecipe %%[#]George's Recipe
records.translation: 想說把手邊這份食譜給你。別把它燒焦了。^   ——喬治%item cookingRecipe %%[#]喬治的食譜

records.source: Dear @,^I usually don't give out my recipes... but since you've been such a sweetheart to George and I, I've written this one down for you. ^   -Evelyn%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Evelyn's Recipe
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^我通常不會把食譜送人……不過你一直對我和喬治這麼好，所以特地替你寫下這份食譜。^   ——伊芙琳%item cookingRecipe %%[#]伊芙琳的食譜

records.source: Hey Kid,^here's the recipe for a little treat my pappy used to make. Cook it slow. ^   -Pam%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Pam's Recipe
records.translation: 嘿，孩子：^這是我老爸以前常做的一道點心的食譜。慢慢煮。^   ——潘姆%item cookingRecipe %%[#]潘姆的食譜

records.source: @,^remember to eat healthy, or you won't have enough energy to work hard! I'm including one of my favorite recipes. Make sure to use ripe tomatoes! ^   -Lewis%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Lewis's Recipe
records.translation: @：^記得要健康飲食，否則可沒有足夠的體力努力工作！隨信附上我最喜歡的一份食譜。一定要用熟透的番茄！^   ——路易斯%item cookingRecipe %%[#]路易斯的食譜

records.source: Dear @,^Here's a recipe from my saloon. I only share this with my good friends! ^   -Gus%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Gus's Recipe
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^這是我酒館裡的一份食譜。我只和好朋友分享！^   ——格斯%item cookingRecipe %%[#]格斯的食譜

records.source: Well, I know a couple of recipes.^I thought I'd send you one... maybe it'll help you mine more ore or something.^Take care. ^   -Clint%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Clint's Recipe
records.translation: 嗯，我知道幾道食譜。^想說寄一份給你……也許能幫你多挖一點礦石之類的。^保重。^   ——克林特%item cookingRecipe %%[#]克林特的食譜

records.source: @,^this recipe of mine won 1st place in a cooking competition! I hope you like it. Thanks for being a friend! ^   -Jodi%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Jodi's Recipe
records.translation: @：^我的這份食譜曾在烹飪比賽中獲得第一名！希望你會喜歡。謝謝你成為我的朋友！^   ——喬迪%item cookingRecipe %%[#]喬迪的食譜

records.source: Picked up this recipe overseas. Enjoy.^Want to say thanks for making me feel welcome. ^^   -Kent%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Kent's Recipe
records.translation: 這份食譜是我在海外學到的。請享用。^謝謝你讓我感受到大家對我的歡迎。^^   ——肯特%item cookingRecipe %%[#]肯特的食譜

records.source: @!^Flip this letter over for instructions on how to make a super-healthy meal!^You'll feel energized. See you soon. ^   -Emily%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Emily's Healthy Recipe
records.translation: @！^把信翻到背面，就能看到一道超級健康料理的製作方法！^吃完會充滿活力。待會兒見。^   ——艾蜜莉%item cookingRecipe %%[#]艾蜜莉的健康食譜

records.source: Dear neighbor,^When I'm not taking care of animals I like to experiment in the kitchen. Since we've become friends I want to share some recipes with you.^I hope you like this! ^   -Marnie%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Marnie's Recipe
records.translation: 親愛的鄰居：^不必照顧動物時，我喜歡在廚房裡嘗試各種料理。既然我們已經成為朋友，我想與你分享一些食譜。^希望你會喜歡！^   ——瑪妮%item cookingRecipe %%[#]瑪妮的食譜

records.source: @,^I found this recipe in a magazine and I thought it sounded interesting. Feel free to give me a taste if you make it. hehe. ^   -Shane%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Shane's Recipe
records.translation: @：^我在雜誌上找到這份食譜，覺得挺有意思。如果做了，儘管拿來給我嘗嘗。嘿嘿。^   ——謝恩%item cookingRecipe %%[#]謝恩的食譜

records.source: Dear @,^I was so bored out here in the desert that I wrote you a letter. There's a recipe for a delicious soup enclosed. Come visit me soon! ^   -Sandy%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Sandy's Recipe
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^我在沙漠裡實在無聊透頂，所以寫了這封信給你。隨信附上一道美味湯品的食譜。快來看我！^   ——珊迪%item cookingRecipe %%[#]珊迪的食譜

records.source: Dear @,^I'd like to share an ol' cooking recipe my pappy used to make. It's important the fish is FRESH.  ^   -Willy%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Willy's Ol' Recipe
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^我想與你分享一份老爸以前常做的老食譜。魚一定要新鮮，這點很重要。  ^   ——威利%item cookingRecipe %%[#]威利的老食譜

records.source: Dear @,^  How are you doing, sweety? I've missed you so much since you left. I hope the farming life is everything you hoped for. ^   Love, Mom.   ^   P.S. I sent your favorite cookies < %item id (O)223 1 %%[#]From Mom
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^  最近過得如何，寶貝？自從你離開後，媽媽一直非常想念你。希望農場生活正如你所期待。^   愛你的媽媽。   ^   附言：寄了你最喜歡的餅乾給你 < %item id (O)223 1 %%[#]來自媽媽

records.source: Dear @,^  It's been so long since I heard from you, dear. Things are the same as ever back home. I miss you very much. ^  Love, Mom ^ P.S. Found an envelope with some money Grandpa left for you. %item money 500 501 %%[#]From Mom #2
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^  親愛的，已經好久沒收到你的消息了。家裡還是老樣子。媽媽非常想念你。^  愛你的媽媽 ^ 附言：找到一個信封，裡面有爺爺留給你的一些錢。%item money 500 501 %%[#]來自媽媽 #2

records.source: Dear @,^  I saw an article about you in the local paper! It sounds like the country life is a good fit for you! I'm so proud of you. Take care, sweety. Love, Mom[#]From Mom #3
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^  我在地方報紙上看到一篇關於你的報導！看來鄉村生活非常適合你！媽媽真為你驕傲。保重，寶貝。愛你的媽媽[#]來自媽媽 #3

records.source: Dear @,^ How are things going? You must really be making a fortune on that farm. Don't forget your dear old mother when you're a millionaire! ^  Love, Mom   ^   P.S. Enjoy the cake!%item id (O)221 1 %%[#]From Mom #4
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^最近過得如何？你一定在那座農場賺了大錢。成為百萬富翁後，可別忘了親愛的老媽！^  愛你的媽媽   ^   附言：好好享用蛋糕！%item id (O)221 1 %%[#]來自媽媽 #4

records.source: Dear @,^  Have you settled into your new life yet? I can't believe you're all grown up now... Time sure flies. Now that you're gone I have all this extra money laying around, so I included a little gift.^  Love, Dad.%item money 500 501 %%[#]From Dad
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^  適應新生活了嗎？真不敢相信你現在已經長大成人……時間過得真快。你離開後，我手邊多出了不少錢，所以隨信附上一份小禮物。^  愛你的爸爸。%item money 500 501 %%[#]來自爸爸

records.source: Dear @,^  How is the country life going for you? It's been lonely here without you, but I'm proud of what you're doing.^  Love, Dad  ^  P.S. Found an envelope with some money Grandpa left for you. %item money 500 501 %%[#]From Dad #2
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^  鄉村生活過得如何？你不在，這裡變得很寂寞，但爸爸為你正在做的事感到驕傲。^  愛你的爸爸  ^  附言：找到一個信封，裡面有爺爺留給你的一些錢。%item money 500 501 %%[#]來自爸爸 #2

records.source: Dear @,^  I read an article about you in the local paper! I'm so impressed with your progress on the farm! Keep this up and dear old Dad might be retiring in a fern islands luxury bungalow after all ;).^  Love, Dad[#]From Dad #3
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^  我在地方報紙上讀到一篇關於你的報導！你在農場的進展實在令我刮目相看！繼續努力，老爸說不定真能退休後住進蕨島群島的豪華度假屋呢 ;)。^  愛你的爸爸[#]來自爸爸 #3

records.source: Dear @,^ I know you're busy on the farm and that's why you can't visit. I understand. You've been working so hard... keep it up and you can accomplish anything! ^ Love, Dad  ^  P.S. Included some quality stone %item id (O)390 30 %%[#]From Dad #4
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^我知道你在農場很忙，所以沒辦法回來看看。我明白。你一直這麼努力……繼續加油，任何事情都能辦到！^愛你的爸爸  ^  附言：附上一些優質石頭 %item id (O)390 30 %%[#]來自爸爸 #4

records.source: Greetings, @.^It is our pleasure to inform you that your farm will be featured in next week's 'up & coming' column of the Stardew Valley Tribune! Congratulations. We're impressed with your quick progress. ^   -SVT[#]News Story
records.translation: 向你致意，@。^我們很榮幸通知你，你的農場將登上《星露谷論壇報》下週的「明日之星」專欄！恭喜。我們對你的迅速進展深感佩服。^   ——《星露谷論壇報》[#]新聞報導

records.source: ADVERTISEMENT:^"I keep finding cool stuff, but my backpack is full!"^^Does this sound like you? Well, Pierre's got you covered!^^Stop by Pierre's General Store TODAY and check out our affordable size 24 backpack!^ See you soon![#]Backpacks From Pierre's
records.translation: 廣告：^「我不斷找到好東西，背包卻滿了！」^^聽起來像不像你？別擔心，皮埃爾幫你想好辦法了！^^今天就來皮埃爾雜貨店，看看我們價格實惠、容量 24 格的背包！^期待很快見到你！[#]皮埃爾的背包

records.source: ADVERTISEMENT:^^Pierre's General Store is now open 7 days a week![#]Pierre's Extended Hours
records.translation: 廣告：^^皮埃爾雜貨店現在每週七天全天營業！[#]皮埃爾延長營業時間

records.source: Dear Farmer @,^^I'd like to apologize for joking about your Grandpa's old cottage when we first met. It's really a nice little house!^^However, you might need some more space someday. That's where I can help. If you bring me some raw materials and pay a fee, I can expand your house.^(Continued on next page)^^The first expansion I offer includes a kitchen. With a kitchen, you'll be able to cook any recipes you've learned!^^Anyway, I hope you're starting to feel at home in Stardew Valley!^^    Your local carpenter,^        Robin[#]Robin's Services
records.translation: 親愛的農夫 @：^^初次見面時，我曾拿你爺爺的老屋開玩笑，想為此向你道歉。那其實是一棟很不錯的小屋！^^不過，總有一天你也許會需要更多空間。這時我就能幫上忙。只要帶來一些原料並支付費用，我就能擴建你的房屋。^（下頁續）^^我提供的第一次擴建會增設廚房。有了廚房，你就能烹調學會的任何食譜！^^總之，希望你開始覺得星露谷就像自己的家！^^    你的本地木匠，^        羅賓[#]羅賓的服務

records.source: @,^I've heard you've been giving some people a hand around town! Everyone seems really thankful. I'm awarding you this month's "Best Neighbor" award (with a small cash prize). Keep it up! ^   -Mayor%item money 500 501 %%[#]Best Neighbor
records.translation: @：^聽說你一直在鎮上幫助大家！每個人似乎都非常感激。我要頒發本月的「最佳鄰居」獎給你（另附一筆小額獎金）。繼續加油！^   ——鎮長%item money 500 501 %%[#]最佳鄰居
